This folder is reserved for GitHub-specific derived assets (social preview,
release banners). Do not place master vector art here — those belong in
branding/. Derived PNG/JPEG assets may be added here as part of a release
process and should be referenced by .github/workflows and release templates.

Example files you may place here (do not add them now):
- social-preview-1200x630.png
- release-banner-core-1200x240.png
- release-banner-ha-1200x240.png
